text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is just around the corner. The summer of the Classic year
is a crucial period for an Umamusume's growth.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed, that shouldn't be an issue.
After that, it'll depend on Gran's condition.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, incorporating some fun is a great idea.
It'll help refresh our mental state too."
choice_data_list: I see. I'll pick out a few options!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, it looks like the summer training camp plans are coming along nicely.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—I received some sweets, so I brought them to share.
Please, help yourselves, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, you're still keeping up
with that 'my-rule' arrangement with Gran Alegria-san, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There's a rumor going around the academy
that you two look like a cute mama duck and her duckling.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, they sure are similar.
...So, did you gain a deeper understanding?
choice_data_list: I feel like there's more I understand now.

text_block_list.text:
By spending more time together,
I've begun to read her moods and behavioral quirks.

I have a feeling that if we keep doing this,
I'll start being able to notice anything unusual.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: That's good. The summer training camp will be a great chance to deepen that understanding even further.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best at the training camp to conquer all three divisions!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories...!
If you pull that off, it'll be a tremendous achievement.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Conquering three divisions...
No, that's right... That all depends on this summer, too.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It depends on how Gran grows this summer.
Depending on how she develops, she might no longer be suited
for conquering the three divisions, right?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: If muscle mass increases too much and weighs you down, or if endurance plateaus, medium-distance races become tough.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, the risks that come with conquering three divisions
will only increase..."
choice_data_list: Adapting to middle distance risks throwing off your sense of pace...

text_block_list.text:
If her distance aptitude drops as she matures,
she will have to drastically change her running style
to adapt to medium distances.
In other words, you'll be recalibrating your "instincts" for controlling your run to suit medium distances.

If those adjustments don't go well...
I might not even be able to get back my old 'feel' for running.
She won't be able to run "Gran Alegria's style of running" anymore.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, depending on how this summer goes—
we may need to reconsider Gran's middle-distance challenge.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The condition to conquer three distance categories is
building a body capable of handling medium distances, and—

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Stabilizing her "senses."
You could call it mental growth.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If the 'sensory feel' that controls your running gets thrown off by your mood,
that is far too precarious.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: We must determine it at this summer training camp. Whether Gran can truly challenge for the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Cases where a girl who excelled through the spring of her Classic Year
becomes completely unable to win from autumn onward... unfortunately, do happen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As if the gears had completely derailed,
she became unable to run...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps going like this, Gran has the talent
to completely dominate both sprints and miles.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
What is the best future for her...?
I want you to give that some serious thought.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm number one again!

text_block_list.name: Ash-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? You're crazy good at jump rope too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Shall we go one more round?

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... you just jumped a second ago.
Gran, did your stamina increase again...?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I can really feel your stamina growing.
Make sure to eat plenty this summer.
Whatever you eat will turn into muscle."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right, plenty of other things besides salad, got it.
Trainer's been telling me that too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'll build up my body properly and conquer all three weight divisions!

text_block_list.name: Wavy Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gran, you're running medium distances too?
Then let's clash on the turf someday.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, please wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I just thought I'd like to have
a heart-to-heart with you for once.

After training, I was invited by Master
to go for a one-on-one drink.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...No, to be completely honest...
I feel like I may have threatened them a bit too much...
choice_data_list: No, I think your point is entirely correct.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No. Because I can't do it myself...
I need you to make the strict calls.
choice_data_list: What do you mean, you can't...?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Conquering all three divisions.
I'm just too deeply attached to it...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...When I first met Gran Alegria,
I thought... it was a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To think another Umamusume with the talent
to challenge three distance categories would appear once more.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: A miraculous talent I once encountered in the past, and a dream I could not pursue with her...
choice_data_list: "The Queen of the Mile," is it...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She was strong...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It was so powerful—in the final stretch,
she burst right through the pack and surged ahead!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Especially the Yasuda Kinen! That was amazing!
On a heavy track in pouring rain, no less.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I lost this race right before the overseas campaign, I'd call off the trip.
I didn't want to go overseas just to get completely crushed, you see...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, she ran brilliantly!
Laughing away all my faint-hearted doubts!"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: And just like that, she went on to win overseas too!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She was undefeated in every mile race she entered!
With her talent, conquering three divisions was entirely possible...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
However... as you know...
she doesn't run middle-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's why even now, I can't help wondering... If it were her, couldn't she have conquered all three divisions?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: We might just have witnessed the ultimate running style—one that conquers even medium distances purely with speed...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
When faced with conquering three divisions, my vision clouds.
My ego as a Trainer starts getting the better of me...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the confidence to stick to 'Uma Musume First'.
I want to see Gran achieve the three-division conquest,
I feel like I'm going to end up thinking that……

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—However, you are different.
You can make decisions purely for Gran's sake.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The reason I decided to lend you a hand
was because you put her best interests first above all else.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
That's why I... believe in your judgment.
"A dream that was so dear to them, it drove even a veteran Trainer to action..."
choice_data_list: (Winning all three divisions is his long-cherished dream.)

text_block_list.text: If it's Gran Alegria, she might just be able to make that dream come true.
I want to show him that very moment.
However—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's next on the menu?
choice_data_list: Slope training, huh. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm, intuitively, I feel a discrepancy of about 0.0002 miles.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to fix it, but it'll probably just slip out of place again in a few days.
Since I'm in a total growth spurt! ☆
choice_data_list: If the gap gets too big, it'll be hard to adjust.
If the gap gets too big, it'll be tough to fix, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right.
Well then, I'll go get a feel for it on the slope!
I will never, ever let her go through that again—

Should I master sprint and mile races as I am?
Or should I take on the challenge of conquering three categories?
"I'll observe her summer training and assess things carefully."
The best possible future for Gran Alegria.
